split.description: Split-season format (efri/nedri hluti): after the regular phase the table splits into an upper group of `upper` and a lower group of `lower` teams (single round-robin each, full carry-over, group-locked final table). Absent = flat league. With this field present, final_positions placement semantics are full-season: placement 1 = champion; relegation places are the bottom of the lower block.
